requirements.evidence: All contract items present: app/Models/Entity.php:23 getRouteKeyName()='slug', :31 memberships(), :39 users(), :51 owner() with ->owner() scope; app/Models/EntityMembership.php:22 role cast to UserRole, :32/:40/:48 local scopes, :56/:64 entity()/user(); app/Models/UserRole.php:4-6 cases, :17 manageable() = [Admin, Employee]; app/Models/User.php:38 memberships(), :46 entities(), :53 membershipFor(); factories with owner/admin/employee states (database/factories/EntityMembershipFactory.php:31/:38/:45); migrations carry the exact named indexes entities_slug_unique (database/migrations/2026_10_29_000001_create_entities_table.php:15), entity_memberships_entity_user_unique and entity_memberships_one_owner (database/migrations/2026_10_29_000002_create_entity_memberships_table.php:21-22) plus the stored generated case expression at :18-20; policies return bool and match every rule (EntityPolicy.php:12-38, EntityMembershipPolicy.php:12-31, including the isOwner-first rule so the owner's membership can never be deleted).

conventions.evidence: Good: reversible down() (database/migrations/2026_10_29_000001_create_entities_table.php:19), deliberate $fillable (app/Models/Entity.php:18, app/Models/EntityMembership.php:16), policies under app/Policies, docs/database-schema.md:3/:139/:151/:163 kept in sync. Deviations: no CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] entry (conventions.md:103); no test at all despite 'no production code without a test' (conventions.md:16); app/Models/User.php:7 uses the #[Fillable]/#[Hidden] attribute style while the new models use $fillable (app/Models/Entity.php:18), and User::membershipFor has no PHPDoc while every sibling method does.

security.evidence: Authorization is entirely in policies and correctly server-side: EntityPolicy.php:17 view requires a membership, :22 update/delete require Owner|Admin, :35 manageSettings requires Owner; EntityMembershipPolicy.php:12 bars non-members, :17 assignRole limits to Owner|Admin, :25 delete blocks the owner row first, then allows self-removal, then Owner|Admin. $fillable is limited to real columns and owner_seq (the generated column) is not fillable, so the invariant cannot be mass-assigned. Minor gap: role itself is mass-assignable (app/Models/EntityMembership.php:18), so a future caller passing request data into create/update could self-promote to owner; no validation layer exists yet either (nothing in this diff accepts input).

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/ files or any test case; grep of the diff shows only models, policies, factories, migrations and docs. The two riskiest requirements — the DB rejecting a second owner (database/migrations/2026_10_29_000002_create_entity_memberships_table.php:18-22) and every policy branch (app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:25-38) — are completely unverified.

simplicity.evidence: Lean and direct: no service/repository layer, delete reuses update (app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:30), factories/states are the minimum the contract asks for. Slightly more code than needed in EntityMembershipPolicy::isOwner (app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:41-45), which tests the same thing twice (enum identity and raw string), the second branch being dead with the cast in place.

readability.evidence: Clear names, small methods, generic PHPDoc on relations and scopes (app/Models/Entity.php:34-56, app/Models/EntityMembership.php:26-64). Deductions: dead defensive branch at app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:44, missing docblock on app/Models/User.php:53, and the doc's column name owner_seq_null (docs/database-schema.md:92) does not match the real column owner_seq (migration line 18).

scope.evidence: Every added file serves the task (two models, enum, two policies, two factories, two migrations, schema doc); nothing from the out-of-scope list (routes, Livewire, middleware, session) appears. One unrelated edit: docs/database-schema.md:33 also drops the documented locale_default column, which the task did not ask for (it only asked to replace owner_membership_id).

issues.explanation: The change ships zero Pest/PHPUnit tests, violating the project's test-first rule, and leaves the DB single-owner invariant and every policy branch (owner cannot be deleted, self-removal, non-member denial) entirely unverified.
No [Unreleased] entry was added even though conventions require CHANGELOG updates for changes like this.
The ER diagram documents the new column as `owner_seq_null`, but the actual column is `owner_seq`, so the updated schema doc is wrong about the column it claims to describe.

`role` is mass-assignable, so a future controller that passes request data to create/update could promote a user to owner (or bypass the owner/admin check) without an explicit, authorized role assignment.
`locale_default` is removed from the documented entities table although the task only asked to replace the owner_membership_id FK, silently dropping a field that belongs to a later task.
The second half of the isOwner check compares the cast role enum to the raw string `UserRole::Owner->value`, which can never be true and misleads readers into thinking the cast may be absent.
New models use the `$fillable` property while the sibling app/Models/User.php:7 uses Laravel's #[Fillable] attribute, so the new files do not match the existing model style.
`membershipFor()` is missing the PHPDoc block that every other touched public method in the change has.

review.summary: The change implements the entity/membership data model end to end — migrations with the named unique indexes and the portable stored generated owner_seq, both Eloquent models, the UserRole enum, factories with states, all requested policy methods and the schema doc update — and the logic reads correct, notably the delete ordering that protects the owner's membership. It cannot be approved as is because it ships no tests at all for the single-owner DB invariant or the policy rules, plus a schema-doc column-name error and a small amount of style/doc drift.
